user.title: EVSCI: Initial Setup
user.description: Connect your sensors. Fields marked [Optional] can be left empty.

data.idle_statuses: Statuses meaning "cable not plugged in" (comma separated)
data.reset_on_unplug: Reset Mode to OFF on Unplug

data_description.grid_sensor: Power sensor (W) at your grid connection point. Positive = importing, negative = exporting.
data_description.charger_start_button: Button that starts charging. Use together with the stop button, or use the switch instead.
data_description.charger_stop_button: Button that stops charging. Use together with the start button, or use the switch instead.
data_description.charger_switch: Single switch that starts (on) and stops (off) charging. Use this instead of the two buttons.
data_description.charger_current: Number entity that sets the charging current in amps.
data_description.charger_power: Sensor with the power the charger is drawing right now (W).
data_description.charger_status: Sensor with the charger status, used to detect when a car is plugged in.
data_description.idle_statuses: Status values that mean no car is connected, separated by commas. Not case sensitive. "unavailable" and "unknown" always count.
data_description.ev_soc_sensor: Car battery level (%). Needed for the Target SoC limit.
data_description.tariff_sensor: Sensor with the current tariff block (1-5). Needed for the Dynamic, Schedule and Low Tariff modes.
data_description.phases: Number of phases of your charger installation.
data_description.max_fuse: Main fuse rating per phase in amps.
data_description.buffer: Safety reserve in watts kept below the limit.
data_description.voltage: Phase voltage used to convert amps to watts.
data_description.min_current: Lowest current the charger can be set to, in amps.
data_description.max_current: Highest current the charger can be set to, in amps.
data_description.fuse_protection: Total house power only, or total plus each phase (3-phase, needs a current sensor per phase).
data_description.control_interval: Minimum time in seconds between current changes while charging. Decreases on overload are immediate.
data_description.auto_mode: Charging mode that is selected when a car is plugged in.
data_description.reset_on_unplug: Switch the mode back to OFF when the car is unplugged.
data_description.limit_block_1: Power limit in watts for tariff block 1.
data_description.limit_block_2: Power limit in watts for tariff block 2.
data_description.limit_block_3: Power limit in watts for tariff block 3.
data_description.limit_block_4: Power limit in watts for tariff block 4.
data_description.limit_block_5: Power limit in watts for tariff block 5.

phases.title: EVSCI: Phase Current Sensors
phases.description: Select the current sensor (A) of each phase at your grid connection point. Sensors that report a sign (import +, export -) work best. A sensor that reports only the magnitude is treated as import, which is the safe side.

data_description.phase_sensor_l1: Current sensor (A) of phase L1 at the grid connection point.
data_description.phase_sensor_l2: Current sensor (A) of phase L2 at the grid connection point.
data_description.phase_sensor_l3: Current sensor (A) of phase L3 at the grid connection point.
data_description.charger_phase: Phase the single-phase charger is connected to.

error.no_start_stop: Select a start and a stop button, or a start/stop switch.
error.entity_not_found: Entity not found: {entity}. Check the selection; if it is disabled or not loaded yet, enable it first.
